## Problem

Surfaced while fixing `anatomical-arbored-oyster` (e3e0-2e7c-b280-4b4a). With the floor leg's build `TypeError` removed, `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` runs the unit tier and emits teardown ERRORs:

```
ERROR at teardown of test_link_success_noop_and_unlink_lines
Failed: New entries appeared in REPO_ROOT during this test: ['.pytest_cache']
tests/conftest.py:379: Failed
```

## Root cause (confirmed)

`tests/conftest.py`'s `_no_repo_root_leaks` guard diffs REPO_ROOT's top-level entries around each test and `pytest.fail`s on any new entry, exempting only coverage.py data files (`_is_coverage_artifact`). `.pytest_cache/` — gitignored (`.gitignore:7`) and written by the pytest framework, not by a test body — was never exempted, so when the floor-leg pytest materializes `.pytest_cache` under REPO_ROOT during a test's wall-clock window (despite `-p no:cacheprovider`) the guard trips at teardown. It is the identical class the guard already treats as non-leaks for coverage. Omission, not regression; change 2420 (`47713c44`) merely EXPOSED it by unblocking the floor unit tier.

## Fix (landed — Gerrit change 2427, MERGED)

Generalized the exemption to the gitignored tool-cache class via a new `_is_framework_artifact` predicate over `_TOOLING_CACHE_ARTIFACTS` = {`.pytest_cache`, `.ruff_cache`, `.mypy_cache`, `.mutmut-cache`, `__pycache__`}. Genuine pollution (any other new entry) still fails and is still named. Regression tests drive the REAL guard (`tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py`): `.pytest_cache` passes; the full exempt class passes against a pinned contract list (teeth: dropping a name → RED); a real leak beside `.pytest_cache` still fails and names only the leak.

## Evidence
- Mirror run 33299427686: `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` job 99224621821 — multiple `ERROR at teardown ... New entries appeared in REPO_ROOT during this test: ['.pytest_cache']`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] The floor `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` leg has no `.pytest_cache` REPO_ROOT-pollution teardown errors. — `.pytest_cache` is now exempt from `_no_repo_root_leaks` (verified: guard passes with `.pytest_cache` present; regression test `test_leak_guard_exempts_pytest_cache`).
- [x] The pollution guard's treatment of `.pytest_cache` is portable (no dependence on a specific pytest version or CI provider). — Exemption is a static name allowlist in conftest (`_TOOLING_CACHE_ARTIFACTS`); no pytest-version- or CI-provider-specific trigger. Verified+1 across ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS py3.13 on change 2427.
